trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through this guide's roadmap in order: story first, then strangers, collectibles, activities and the money clean-up. The last trophy you earn will usually be 100% completion or one of the big grinds, so save those for the end.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order
The platinum unlocks as soon as the final one pops
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn and it cannot be missed. Play through the intro as directed: follow the on-screen prompts, drive where the game tells you to, and finish the mission's final objective. The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing
Follow the mission objectives to the end
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 covers the opening stretch of the story, ending once its final mission is complete. Just keep playing the gold story missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's closing cutscene. There is no side requirement: chapter completion is automatic story progress.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 1
Finish the chapter's final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 continues the story after Chapter 1, and like every chapter trophy it unlocks automatically when the chapter's last mission ends. Play the story missions in order; free-roam detours between missions never block chapter progress. The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 2
Finish the chapter's final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the story's mid-point stretch, and its trophy is another automatic unlock for finishing the chapter. Keep following the gold mission markers and complete each mission as it comes. Nothing in Chapter 3 can lock you out of this trophy.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 3
Finish the chapter's final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the last full chapter before the finale, so this trophy marks that you are nearly done with the story. Finish its missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. If you are hunting missables, make sure the mission-linked ones are done before you move past this chapter.
steps: Play every story mission in Chapter 4
Finish the chapter's final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the story's finish line: complete the final mission and the credits roll. It unlocks for any ending path, since the requirement is simply finishing the last mission. Before you start it, grab any story-locked missables, because some content closes once the story ends.
steps: Finish Chapters 1 to 4
Complete the final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission, so this trophy is unmissable: play the mission when it appears on the map and complete its objectives. The mission's name hints at a morning errand, so expect a drive-and-deliver structure with a short action beat. The trophy pops when the mission-complete screen shows.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in the story
Complete all of its objectives
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the story's big set-piece missions, and finishing it unlocks this trophy automatically. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first, so complete any setup objectives the game gives you, then play the heist itself to the end. There is no optional objective tied to this trophy.
steps: Complete any setup objectives for The Cartel Heist
Play the heist mission through to the end
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission, so just play it when it unlocks and finish it to earn this trophy. Story missions cannot be failed permanently: if you fail an objective, the game lets you retry from the last checkpoint. The trophy unlocks on the mission-complete screen.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in the story
Complete all of its objectives
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission whose completion unlocks this trophy, and it cannot be missed by playing the story normally. Expect a high-profile target or event, given the name, and follow the mission markers through each phase. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in the story
Complete all of its objectives
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around Vice City International Airport, and completing it earns this bronze trophy. Play it when it appears in the story and finish every objective. Do the missable trophy Catch Me If You Can in this same mission window, before you finish the takedown, since its escape moment belongs to this mission.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in the story
Attempt the Catch Me If You Can escape during this mission
Complete the mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a late-story military-style mission, and finishing it unlocks this trophy. It is unmissable story progress: play the mission when it appears and work through its objectives. If a checkpoint fails you, retry from the checkpoint and keep going until the mission-complete screen.
steps: Reach the Operation Savage Glory mission in the story
Complete all of its objectives
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the long grind behind the platinum: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. The checklist covers the story, stranger missions, collectibles, activities and challenges, so it is effectively a summary of this whole guide. Track it in the pause menu's stats screen and finish whatever category is lowest first.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger mission strands
Complete every collectible set and activity category
Check the stats screen until completion reads 100%
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are the game's driving tricks: jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and other skill moves the game scores as you drive. The counter runs across the whole game, so 250 builds up naturally if you drive fast and take jumps whenever you see them. To grind it, chain jumps off ramps and hills in free roam and watch the stunt counter climb in the stats screen.
steps: Drive fast, take jumps and chain stunt moves in free roam
Repeat until the stats screen shows 250 stunts
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Leonida offers 9 activity types, and this trophy only asks you to try each one once, not to master any of them. The types are the game's side activities: races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and similar diversions. Open the map, find one of each icon, and do a single round of each.
steps: Open the map and find the 9 activity icons
Try one round of each activity type
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges, and this silver trophy needs a gold medal in every one of them. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so learn the target patterns first with a slow run, then push for the gold time. Use the weapon the challenge gives you, aim for headshots where they score best, and replay any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list
Earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges, replaying any that fall short
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations across Leonida, and you must win at each one. Drone races reward tight cornering and cutting the racing line, so learn each course's turns on a first attempt and race cleanly on the second. The map marks each race location, and the trophy pops after the 14th win.
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations on the map
Win a race at every location
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: You need wins in 20 different races, so variety matters more than repeating one easy race. The race list spans street races, off-road events and other formats across the map, and each counts once. Work through the map's race icons one by one, pick a fast car suited to each surface, and bank each first win before moving on.
steps: Open the map and list the race locations
Win 20 different races, one win per race
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival, and this trophy is won by beating him in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges score the catch, so pick a good spot, cast where the fish are biting, and reel steadily without snapping the line. If you lose the first challenge, you can challenge Cal again, so keep at it until you out-fish him.
steps: Find a fishing challenge against Cal
Out-fish him to win the challenge
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Arcades around Leonida hold playable cabinet games, and finishing any one of them earns this trophy. Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it through to its end screen. It does not matter which game you choose or how high you score: completion is all that counts.
steps: Enter an arcade and pick any cabinet game
Play it through to completion
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the stranger contacts with a mission strand, and this trophy unlocks when you finish the last mission in his strand. Stranger missions appear as question-mark icons on the map, so visit Andy whenever his marker shows and work through his jobs in order. His final mission is the payoff, so finish the strand before the story ends to be safe.
steps: Follow Andy's stranger missions as they appear on the map
Complete his final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand is another stranger mission chain, and its final mission earns this trophy. The name points to a boating mishap, so expect water and boats to feature in his jobs. Take his missions as they appear on the map and finish the chain; like the other stranger strands, do it before the story's end.
steps: Follow Kenton's stranger missions as they appear on the map
Complete his final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is a stranger mission chain built around riding, and its last mission unlocks this trophy. Visit Billy's marker whenever it appears and play his missions in order until the strand closes. Stranger strands are best cleared as you go, so do not leave Billy's jobs until after the finale.
steps: Follow Billy's stranger missions as they appear on the map
Complete his final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 8 stranger mission strands scattered across Leonida, and this silver trophy needs all of them finished. Stranger missions show as question-mark markers on the map, and each strand is a short chain with its own contact. Clear each strand when it appears rather than saving them all for the end, and this trophy pops when the eighth strand closes.
steps: Find stranger markers on the map across Leonida
Complete all 8 stranger mission strands
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is a stranger mission chain about supply runs, and finishing its last mission earns this trophy. Follow his marker on the map and play his jobs in order until the strand ends. As with the other named contacts, clear Randy's strand before the story finale so nothing is left hanging.
steps: Follow Randy's stranger missions as they appear on the map
Complete his final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is another stranger mission chain, and its final mission unlocks this trophy. His jobs appear as a map marker, so take them in order and see the strand through to its end. Finish all five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus the other three to complete the Strangers & Freaks set as well.
steps: Follow Tyrone's stranger missions as they appear on the map
Complete his final mission
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and this trophy needs a session at each one. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points, usually marked on the map once discovered, so visit each, sit down and complete the session. Work through them region by region and tick each off the tracker as you go, since the spots are easy to lose track of.
steps: Find the 18 meditation spots across Leonida
Meditate at every spot
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a unique animal hunted, so this trophy is a single guided hunt rather than general hunting. Take Bret's mission when it appears, follow the tracking clues to the animal's area, and take the shot when you have a clear line. A scoped rifle and patience help: the animal is unique, so the hunt is a one-off encounter.
steps: Take Bret's hunting mission
Track the unique animal and take it down
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in sets, and this silver trophy needs 3 full sets completed. Cards are tucked into corners, interiors and landmarks, so search thoroughly and use the map's collectible hints where the game shows them. Complete any 3 sets; the tracker in this guide can hold your progress per set while you hunt.
steps: Search Leonida for collectible cards
Complete 3 full card sets
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It is a photo-spot activity: find 100 marked locations and snap them. The locations span landmarks, viewpoints and oddities across the state, and each one counts when the game registers the shot. Work region by region with the map open, and the counter in the stats screen shows how many of the 100 you have banked.
steps: Find WAiNK It photo locations across Leonida
Photograph all 100 locations
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's small objectives: driving feats, combat goals, exploration tasks and more, tracked in the pause menu. You need 50 completed, and the easiest ones go first, so clear the simple driving and exploration challenges early. The counter climbs across all play, so this trophy usually pops during the clean-up phase.
steps: Open the challenges list in the pause menu
Complete any 50 challenges
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be present, so start this during a mission or activity where your partner rides along. Once the wanted level hits 4 stars, break line of sight, hide until the stars blink, then stay out of sight until the heat is gone.
steps: Have your partner with you and raise your wanted level to 4 stars
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between robberies: the chain breaks if the heat drops. Pick 3 shops close together, rob each quickly, and move straight to the next while the cops are still after you. Do not hide or wait between shops, and keep your partner close.
steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 shops close together
Rob all 3 in a row without losing your wanted level
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discovering a vehicle means getting close enough for the game to log it, and 100 different vehicles are needed. Leonida's roads, parking lots and car meets are full of variety, so drive everywhere and let the discovery counter tick up. Rare and parked cars count too, so walk through lots and showrooms as well as driving.
steps: Drive and walk through varied areas of Leonida
Discover 100 different vehicles
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the game's slow-aim mode, and this trophy needs 5 takedowns inside one single use of it. Find a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped up, trigger Combat Focus, and drop them quickly before the meter runs out. A fast-firing weapon and headshots make the window easier; retry the same fight if you fall one short.
steps: Find a fight with 5 or more enemies close together
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: This is a MISSABLE trophy: the unscheduled departure happens at Vice City International Airport during the VCIA Takedown story mission, and the window closes when the mission ends. During the mission, when you reach the airport, leave by an unplanned route instead of following the scripted exit: steal a plane or vehicle and get out of the airport grounds. Do it before the mission's final objective completes, or the chance is gone and a new playthrough is needed.
steps: Start the VCIA Takedown story mission
At the airport, make an unscheduled departure before the mission ends
If it does not pop, replay the mission before finishing the story
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this trophy is about dealing with them when they show up at high wanted levels. Push your wanted level up until Rhinos roll in, then survive the encounter: use cover, sticky explosives or a heavy weapon, and keep moving so the cannon cannot pin you down. The trophy pops once you have handled the Rhinos the game throws at you.
steps: Raise your wanted level until Rhinos (tanks) arrive
Survive and deal with the Rhinos
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store, get in and out with the goods, and never let anyone spot you. Go in quiet: move slowly, stay out of sight lines, take the loot and leave before the alarm trips. If you are detected, the attempt fails, so leave and try again rather than fighting your way out.
steps: Choose a jewelry store and enter quietly
Take the loot and leave without being detected
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: There are bank vaults to rob across Leonida, and this silver trophy needs 5 robbed with a clean escape each time. Each vault is a planned job: break in, crack the vault, grab the cash and get out before the response arrives. Escape cleanly after each one; the counter only counts vaults you rob and escape from.
steps: Find a bank vault and rob it
Escape cleanly, then repeat for 5 vaults in total
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, and this trophy is a classic intercept: stop one, crack it open, take the cash and escape. Block the truck with your own vehicle or force it to stop, then deal with its guards quickly and get clear before backup arrives. The trophy pops once you escape with the money.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and stop it
Take the cash and escape
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leonida has 52 named areas, and this trophy needs every one of them visited. The map reveals each area as you enter it, so a systematic drive works best: sweep the map region by region and watch the explored count rise. The last few areas are usually the small or out-of-the-way ones, so check the map for any patch still fogged or unvisited.
steps: Drive through Leonida region by region
Visit all 52 areas until the map is fully explored
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations around Leonida, and this trophy needs one operation robbed from each of them. Illegal operations are marked gang turf with guards and stash, so scout each site, hit it, and get out with the take. Work through the gangs one by one and use this guide's tracker to note which gangs you have already hit.
steps: Find an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs
Rob one operation per gang
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This is a MISSABLE trophy: the cocktail moment on Ocean Beach belongs to a specific story scene early in the game, and the scene does not repeat. When the story takes you to Ocean Beach for a quiet moment, take the cocktail when the game offers it instead of rushing past the prompt. If you skip the drink, the moment is gone for that playthrough, so slow down and enjoy the view.
steps: Reach the Ocean Beach story scene
Take the cocktail when the game offers it
Do not skip the scene's prompt
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This is a MISSABLE trophy: the showroom smash is a scripted story beat, and once that scene passes you cannot stage it again. When the story puts you in a vehicle showroom, drive straight out through the glass in classic style instead of using the door. It is a one-shot moment, so do it the first time the scene plays.
steps: Reach the vehicle showroom story scene
Smash out through the showroom glass in a vehicle
Do it on the first play of the scene
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This is a MISSABLE trophy: the bowling follow-through happens at the Kolt & Associates alley during a specific story visit, and the scene does not come back. When the story takes you to that alley, bowl a full game and follow through on your throws instead of leaving early. Complete the visit properly and the trophy pops before you move on.
steps: Reach the Kolt & Associates bowling alley story visit
Bowl and follow through on your throws
Finish the visit before leaving the alley
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This is a MISSABLE trophy: the partnership moment with mass appeal is a single story scene, and it only plays once. When the story stages the big public moment with your partner, play it all the way through and do not skip the cutscene or rush the beat. The trophy is tied to that scene, so give it your full attention the first time it runs.
steps: Reach the partnership's big public story scene
Play the scene through without skipping
The trophy pops at the scene's end
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices are counted across the game, and this trophy tracks them up to 500: dialogue picks, mission decisions and small moral calls all add up. There is no single right answer, so just keep making choices whenever the game offers one instead of letting prompts time out. The counter climbs over a full playthrough and usually completes near the end of the clean-up.
steps: Make a choice whenever the game offers one
Keep choosing through the story until the count reaches 500
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This trophy is about succeeding on the second try: fail an attempt at something, then succeed when you try it again. The natural way is to fail a mission objective or an activity once, then pass it on the immediate retry. If it does not pop on its own, pick any repeatable activity, fail it deliberately, and then complete it on the next attempt.
steps: Fail an activity or mission objective once
Succeed on the immediate second attempt
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This trophy is a strange random event: something unexplained happens in the world, and witnessing it earns the trophy. These events trigger in specific places at specific times, so explore odd corners of the map, especially at night, and keep an eye out for anything out of place. If nothing triggers, keep exploring: the event is rare, not missable.
steps: Explore unusual spots around Leonida, especially at night
Witness the strange event when it triggers
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, and this trophy wants a bowling-style knockdown: send them flying. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon from the car, and aim to knock them down in one hit. It may take a few passes to land cleanly, so retry in a quiet street.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car
Drive past a pedestrian and land a melee drive-by knockdown
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and they must be laundered through your contacts before they count as clean money. Hand the bills to a contact, take the laundered cut, and repeat until the laundered total reaches $250,000. Big heists pay the fastest, so run the bank vaults and the cartel jobs to build up marked cash.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists
Launder them through contacts until $250,000 is cleaned
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across Leonida's shops: clothes, weapons, car parts, food and anything else with a price tag. The total is cumulative across all shops and all play, so it builds naturally as you gear up. If you are short near the end, buy expensive items such as high-end cars or weapon upgrades to close the gap.
steps: Shop normally through the story and side content
Top up with big purchases until $100,000 total is spent
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida, and this trophy needs all of them bought. Garage properties appear on the map once you can afford them, so save up and buy each one as you find it. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover, which helps the vehicle trophy too.
steps: Find the 8 garage properties for sale
Purchase all 8
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles, and this trophy needs 10 registered. Get into a vehicle, open the app on your phone, and register it; repeat with 10 different vehicles. Any car, bike or truck counts, so register the ones you drive most and the trophy pops on the tenth.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app while in a vehicle
Register 10 different vehicles
